summary: CONSENT at 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX. The frozen 0444 turn-3 subject remains at the required digest; HEAD, COORD, file 08, the last heading, and both prior frozen subjects reproduce. The eleven predecessor/successor rows, twenty-eight recording headings, eight citing-file hashes and rows, ten citation pairs, all first quoted sites, and the widened 35-site census reproduce with per-pair counts [4,4,4,2,2,5,4,3,2,5]. Every leftoverDesign partition is equal. All ten clause-2(b) projections pass: registerRow is equal; file08StatusToken and liveGateOwners are equal wherever the cited version carries the field; every named obligation has equal presence and, where present, equal leftoverDesign, existingGate, rideStanding, and executionObligationOwnerToday; every still-measures assertion agrees. D-272 remains CONTESTED and off the no-cell branch. All eleven prior findings are named and no longer stand. D-000 authority and D-293's user-made authorization hold; no protected file or readiness standing changes.

The Protocol line names all seven turn-1 and all four turn-2 finding identifiers, maps each repair location or class, and says none was rejected.
The same 35-site headline and ten corrected Sites cells independently reproduce under the stated grammar.
The rationale now states that D-287 was occupancy-only and had no cross-lineage leftover-join citation to refresh.
